# execution), as distinct from supplementary/*.qmd's "notebooks with

#
# To surface a new appendix in the site navigation, add it under the
# "Appendices" section's `contents:` in _quarto.yml, same pattern as the
# entry already there for this file.
title: "Appendix A: Example"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Needed even though this appendix has no R content of its own -
# _back-to-manuscript.qmd's include below has a hidden chunk that calls
# here::here("R/functions.R"), and here() needs *this* document's own
# i_am() call to anchor correctly - confirmed by direct testing: this
# renders fine under tar_quarto() (cwd = repo root there always masks a
# missing anchor) but fails under a direct `quarto render` from inside
# manuscript/ without it. Every notebook needs this, "no R code" or not.
here::i_am("manuscript/appendices/appendix-a-example.qmd")
```

This is a placeholder appendix — static content with no R code, for
material that belongs with the manuscript (extended methods, a
questionnaire, raw supporting text) but doesn't need `targets`/knitr to
